capabilities: Create flashcards inside notes and organize them into projects
Review cards with FSRS v6 scheduling and Again/Hard/Good/Easy ratings
Generate flashcards from selected text with an AI inbox workflow
Import Anki .apkg decks and export to Anki or CSV/TSV
Track review statistics and embed inline dashboard widgets in notes
extras: Freemium: core features are free, True Recall Pro is a paid hosted-AI option. Requires Obsidian 1.11.4+ for the SecretStorage API. Full documentation lives on an external docs site; the README links there for a complete walkthrough. Beta builds are available via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no native flashcard review system, so learners must leave the app or maintain decks in a separate tool like Anki.
